newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB sees double-digit profit growth.
newsitem.headline: DRB sees double-digit profit growth.

text.p: Automotive firm urces Bhd (DRB) said on Thursday it hopes to achieve double-digit growth in its profits in its current year, but would be hard pressed to maintain the triple digit profit rise seen in the last financial year.
"We hope to continue double-digit growth (in profits)," DRB-Hicom senior group director Maznah Abdul Jalil told a news conference.

But she said it would be difficult to match the 166 percent rise in group net profit to 125.85 million ringgit ($49.9 million) achieved for the year ended March 31 1997 or the year's 206 percent surge in pre-tax profit to 304.71 million ringgit.

Maznah said double-digit profit growth will be aided by new projects like new automobile and transportation services and a tilting train project. DRB's motorcycle production will also start yielding greater profit, she added.
She attributed the last year's sharp growth in profits to investments and strategies put in place over the last three years that were yielding results.

Within the group, Gadek (M) Bhd reported net profit of 201.13 million ringgit for the 15 months ended March 31, 1997. In the year ended December 31, 1995, it earned net profit of 41.28 million ringgit.
The company changed its accounting period from December 31 to March during the period.
Gadek is involved in automotive, finance and construction.

Another DRB-related company, Gadek Capital Bhd, reported net profit of 48.56 million ringgit for the 15 months ended March 31, 1997. For the proforma 12 months ended December 31, 1995, it earned net profit of 23.14 million ringgit.
Gadek Capital, a financial services firm, also changed its financial year end from December 31 to March 31.
